name: Ruellia

project_scope.note: The source pool contains historical names now represented by canonical Ruellia ciliatiflora. Preserve those names for provenance and field-literature continuity without creating duplicate learner pages.

priority: terminal/peduncled versus axillary/nearly sessile flower position
long-pilose versus fine short pubescence versus nearly glabrous foliage
study_strategy.warning: Do not identify these from purple flower color alone. Flower position and hair type are the fastest field split.

quick_key.if: purple/violet flowers raised above the foliage on conspicuous peduncled branching terminal or upper-axillary cymes; foliage mostly glabrous to inconspicuously hairy
quick_key.then: Ruellia ciliatiflora (= R. nudiflora / R. occidentalis source concepts)

quick_key.if: purple flowers/cymes essentially sessile in the leaf axils; stems and leaves finely short-pubescent; capsule with only 2–4 seeds
purple flowers nearly sessile in leaf axils AND stems/leaves/margins conspicuously long-pilose or shaggy
large white to pale flowers in a terminal branching panicle; upper inflorescence and calyx densely stalked-glandular-hairy

taxonomy_note: Current Kew/POWO accepts Ruellia ciliatiflora Hook. and places Ruellia nudiflora and Ruellia occidentalis in synonymy. The project keeps historical Texas source names as aliases while using one canonical R. ciliatiflora learner.
look_here_first: Opposite leaves and funnel-shaped, 5-lobed corollas suggest Ruellia; first trace each flower stalk to distinguish terminal/upper-axillary peduncled cymes from nearly sessile leaf-axil flowers. Next magnify stem and leaf-edge hairs, then inspect calyx glands and ripe capsule/seed count.
shared_traits: Funnel-shaped corolla with five spreading lobes
Flowers borne in terminal/upper-axillary branched clusters or axillary nearly sessile clusters depending on species

species_comparison_matrix.stem_leaf_hairs: Nearly glabrous to inconspicuous short hairs
species_comparison_matrix.fruit: Pubescent capsule; count seeds where mature
species_comparison_matrix.look_first: Follow stalk above foliage; check leaf hair density

species_comparison_matrix.fruit: 2–4 seeds per capsule in canonical review
species_comparison_matrix.look_first: Inspect leaf axil, then count mature seeds

species_comparison_matrix.stem_leaf_hairs: Conspicuous long pilose hairs and ciliate leaf margins
species_comparison_matrix.calyx: Check hairs in same focal plane as leaf margin
species_comparison_matrix.fruit: Generally more than 2–4 seeds; confirm with mature fruit

species_comparison_matrix.stem_leaf_hairs: Upper inflorescence and calyx densely stalked-glandular-hairy
species_comparison_matrix.fruit: Seed counts need verified matched fruit
species_comparison_matrix.look_first: Terminal branching cluster + calyx gland macro

overlap_cautions: R. ciliatiflora and R. metziae both carry raised terminal/upper-axillary clusters; use stalked calyx/inflorescence glands and floral details rather than corolla color alone.
R. humilis and R. drummondiana both have axillary nearly sessile flowers; compare actual hair length on matching stem/leaf positions and mature capsule seed number.
Flower color is not an independent diagnosis; lighting, age, and pale morphs can mislead.
R. nudiflora, R. occidentalis and R. nudiflora var. nudiflora are represented source concepts under canonical R. ciliatiflora, not extra species.
realistic_lookalikes: Ruellia simplex — long, narrow lanceolate leaves and a typically taller habit; a landscape escape that requires structural confirmation
Justicia species — bilabiate flowers and different capsule/inflorescence architecture
Dyschoriste linearis — smaller axillary flowers, narrow foliage, and distinct calyx/capsule morphology

roles: whole terminal cymes with stalk traced to node: R. ciliatiflora and R. metziae
matched leaf-axil flower attachment: R. drummondiana and R. humilis
same-scale stem and leaf-margin macros: long pilose R. humilis vs short pubescent R. drummondiana vs sparse-haired R. ciliatiflora
lateral calyx and upper peduncle macros with scale: R. metziae vs R. ciliatiflora
opened mature capsule and all seeds in one frame: R. drummondiana vs R. humilis
opposite node, corolla front/side, mature capsule

handoffs.question: Verify consistent non-color gland density/type and calyx measurements in matched local material before assigning a numeric couplet.
